sources: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530153 (every site's details page and 1-night price for 2027-06-15; sampled sites 2026-11-10, 2026-11-14, 2027-06-19)

values.note: Every campsite is a 'Campsite Electric' with water: 72 sites are $36 a night (55 of them take a 23-ft rig) and 37 are $42, among them the 12 full-hookup sites 101-114. Same price Tuesday 2026-11-10, Saturday 2026-11-14 and Saturday 2027-06-19 ($252 / $294 a week). Backcountry sites $12. The park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay ... Parking is not included with reservation.'

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530153 (site pages: Campsite 527 '$36.00 Per Night', Campsite 105 '$42.00 Per Night' on all three sampled dates) + https://gastateparks.org/FDRoosevelt (Parking: 'Fee required'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530153 site details (116 'Campsite Electric' sites, all 'Water Hookup: Y'; 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30' at 34 public sites, 30 at the rest; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' at the 12 public sites 101-110, 113, 114 and at the 7 host sites) + park map legend '30/50 Amp' and 'Full Hook Up' on loop #1, read 2026-10-29

values.note: 116 electric sites on the booking site, 7 of them host sites, leaving 109 for the public (the park page says 115); 90 take a 23-ft rig ('Max Vehicle Length' 23-100 ft; 15 sites are 15 ft and a few 14-22 ft, mostly in loop #6); 28 pull-throughs. Six loops north of Lake Delanor (#1-#3, #5, #6 and the 300/400 rows); 21 backcountry sites besides.

sites.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530153 site details ('Max Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry') + https://gastateparks.org/FDRoosevelt ('115 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '21 Backcountry Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/FDRoosevelt ('Make a Reservation' to gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530153), read 2026-10-29

note: Largest GA state park. Wooded campground at the edge of Lake Deleanor, a small fishing lake; the CCC-built Liberty Bell Pool is seasonal. --Claude
summary: Park page + map + ReserveAmerica catalog: $36 (72 sites) / $42 (37 sites incl. 12 full hookups), unchanged Nov 2026 / Jun 2027, weekday and Saturday; 109 public electric+water sites (116 less 7 host), 50 A at 34, sewer at 12 public sites; 90 fit 23 ft (max 100 ft, 28 pull-throughs); dump station. Count 115 -> 109. Showers (note-derived) left as is - pages silent. Pin is inside the campground area north-east of the lake (no flag). Note trimmed of counts/booking/facility facts; 'pool/beach' cut to the pool (the park page lists a seasonal Liberty Bell Pool, no beach); '15-acre' dropped (page says 'small fishing lake').
